_comment: Every value used in more than one place. Read by config/contracts.mjs, which validates it at service start. Keys starting with _ are documentation. Instance values (project, role, bucket, paths) are not here: they are written at install to /etc/paraclete/instance.json (config/instance.mjs). Settings a dashboard admin changes (effort, Claude on or off) live in Firestore config/settings.
_bounds: A bound exists to stop an unbounded blowup, not to save money: every budget is sized for the work to succeed, then bounded, and every cap announces itself so an organ can re-derive instead of assuming it saw everything. Two ceilings are storage limits, enforced by config/contracts.mjs: brain.context_token_budget <= 125000, because accumulated context persists on the envelope (a Firestore document, 1 MiB) at about 4 characters per token; and compaction.working_budget_tokens <= brain.context_token_budget. Nothing here may become unbounded.

vertex._models_comment: Organ model tiers. cortex decides each step; strong serves prefrontal, motor and cerebellum; fast serves the temporal organs; fallback is where a failed turn continues. claude is the model the cortex and strong tier move to when an admin turns Claude on (after accepting Anthropic's terms in Model Garden); Gemini stays the fallback.

gateway._loop_guard_comment: Stuck-loop bounds. duplicate_* count identical arguments (a pointless repeat and legitimate polling look the same). identical_result_* count byte-identical results for the same arguments, a proven no-op, so they are tighter. semantic_* bound varying-argument loops, where a single warning was ignorable.

organs._comment: Tool-call budget for one organ turn in the gateway. Distinct from brain.max_iterations, the mission's decide-loop cap. A full coding task (read, edit, serve and check, diff, commit) needs more than 12 steps.

tools._comment: A tool result is context: bound it, announce the bound, and never let a binary file reach a model.

record._comment: What the tool log keeps of each result for everyone after the organ that ran it. Up to verbatim_chars is kept word for word; a larger result is stored in full in tool_results (expiring after store_ttl_days) and replaced in the log by a digest plus its reference. Never cut silently.

brain._verify_comment: The verifier's first look uses compact result packets (every tool result, not the organ's prose); full motor output is kept for the one re-verification that a missing-evidence failure or a known-truncated view triggers. verify_prompt_max_chars bounds the whole prompt, which keeps Gemini clear of malformed tool calls on very large prompts.
brain._spine_comment: A failed checkpoint re-plans that checkpoint, not the mission. Outcomes and verdicts stay pinned; the acceptance criteria may be refined at most max_criteria_revisions times.
brain._transition_guard_comment: Every envelope status change goes through agent/work/work-transitions.mjs. enforce refuses an illegal change; observe only logs it.

archival._comment: The periodic sweep (agent/work/archival.mjs). A timed wait is never cancelled before its resume time; waiting_timeout_hours applies only to waits without one, and must exceed brain.wait_max_minutes.

delivery._comment: Mouth retry discipline: exponential backoff between failed attempts, then delivery_status 'failed' after max_attempts.

organ_context._tool_answer_comment: For a tool-using organ's result, prose outside the tool log shorter than this means the tool results are the answer, so the summary digests them instead of eliding the log.

utility._comment: The fast model the services call directly for small jobs.

resource_ledger._comment: An outside identifier (a Drive folder, a Chat space) does not change: resolve it once, remember it on the envelope, never search again. Promotion into Core Memory is the temporal-memory organ's job during consolidation.

git._comment: The git artifact store: repositories as bundles in the instance's bucket, under prefix.

files._comment: Files going out to people and coming in from them, in the instance's bucket under prefix (out/ and in/).

responsibility_store._comment: The agent's own responsibilities, merged over the role packages' installed defaults every refresh_ms. min_interval_minutes is the floor between two runs of a schedule the agent writes; max_own caps the responsibilities it owns outright.

control._comment: The control service (agent/services/control): how often it polls for dashboard commands, how long it waits for a restarted gateway to be ready, and the longest an upgrade may run.

effort._comment: The dashboard's effort setting, stored in Firestore config/settings. One of low, medium, high, max.

versioning._comment: The commit and release version format. The dashboard parses versions with canonical_regex.
